verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm https://developers.deepgram.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section. Every docs page is also available as clean Markdown by appending .md, and an openapi.json is served. A second, curated llms.txt at deepgram.com summarizes the core APIs, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these llms.txt and Markdown docs in practice.
